cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.description: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.description: With cells similar to those of plants, it performs photosynthesis inside its body and creates pure air.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees F.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.description: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional-medicine ingredients.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.description: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can't be seen when it melts away into water.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.description: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.description: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.description: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.description: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.description: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.description: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.description: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.description: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.description: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148° F.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.description: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: By storing electricity in its body, it can shoot its bristlelike fur like a barrage of missiles.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

cards.name: Nidoran♀
cards.description: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from its barbs can be fatal.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.description: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than Nidorino's.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.description: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

cards.name: Nidoran♂
cards.description: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.description: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

cards.name: Muk
cards.description: It's so stinky! Muk's body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.description: Its fur is so sensitive, it can feel minute shifts in the air and predict the weather…and its foes' thoughts.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.description: Its cells are all magnetic, and it communicates with others by using magnetic pulses.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.description: With four linked brains, it's more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.description: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.description: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.description: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.description: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.description: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.description: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: Opening its large mouth, it ingests massive amounts of soil and creates long tunnels.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.description: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.description: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.description: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it's filled with a mysterious power.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: A smart and sneaky Pokémon, it makes its opponents flinch by suddenly showing the claws hidden in its paws.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: It appears from deep in the mountains to warn people about upcoming disasters it has sensed with its horn.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.description: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.description: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: The iron it ingested with the soil it swallowed transformed its body and made it harder than diamonds.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.description: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.description: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.description: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.description: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.description: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world's ways.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.description: It is said that kids who drink Miltank's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.description: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

cards.name: Starly
cards.description: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.description: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.description: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
